goal_level_requirements.title: User Registration
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow new users to register ATM accounts.

goal_level_requirements.title: ATM Login
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall authenticate customers using card number and PIN.

goal_level_requirements.title: Cash Withdrawal
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to withdraw money from their accounts.

goal_level_requirements.title: Cash Deposit
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to deposit money into their accounts.

goal_level_requirements.title: Balance Enquiry
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall display current account balance information.

goal_level_requirements.title: PIN Change
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall allow customers to change ATM PIN.

goal_level_requirements.title: Mini Statement
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall display recent transaction history.

goal_level_requirements.title: Fast Cash
goal_level_requirements.description: The system shall provide predefined withdrawal shortcuts.

interaction_level_requirements.description: The system shall accept card number and PIN input from the customer.
The system shall validate card number and PIN against the database.
The system shall reject invalid login credentials.
The system shall display the transaction menu after successful authentication.
The system shall accept withdrawal amount input.
The system shall verify sufficient account balance before withdrawal.
The system shall deduct the withdrawal amount from the account balance.
The system shall persist withdrawal transaction records into the database.
The system shall display withdrawal success or failure messages.
